content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make a crab and spring onion omelette, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sharpen the kitchen knife (2 minutes)
Step 2. Whisk the eggs in a ceramic bowl (1 minute)
Step 3. Dice the red chili peppers (3 minutes)
Step 4. Warm the serving plates in the oven (5 minutes)
Step 5. Clean the kitchen counter (5 minutes)
Step 6. Take the eggs out of the refrigerator (30 seconds)
Step 7. Finely chop the spring onions (4 minutes)
Step 8. Pick through the fresh crab meat for shell fragments (10 minutes)
Step 9. Grate the zest of one lime (2 minutes)
Step 10. Prepare a small side salad (6 minutes)
Step 11. Rinse the fresh herbs (1 minute)
Step 12. Melt a knob of butter in the pan (2 minutes)
Step 13. Drain the crab meat of excess moisture (3 minutes)
Step 14. Measure out the fish sauce (1 minute)
Step 15. Mix the crab with a teaspoon of ginger (2 minutes)
Step 16. Crack the eggs into a measuring jug (2 minutes)
Step 17. Season the egg mixture with salt and pepper (30 seconds)
Step 18. Set the table with cutlery and napkins (4 minutes)
Step 19. Pour a glass of chilled white wine (1 minute)
Step 20. Heat the non-stick skillet over medium heat (3 minutes)
Step 21. Finely mince a clove of garlic (2 minutes)
Step 22. Add a splash of heavy cream to the eggs (30 seconds)
Step 23. Lightly sauté the aromatics (3 minutes)
Step 24. Prepare the garnish of coriander leaves (2 minutes)
Step 25. Check the seasoning of the crab filling (1 minute)
Step 26. Wash the mixing spoons (2 minutes)
Step 27. Retrieve the omelette spatula from the drawer (30 seconds)
Step 28. Pour the egg mixture into the hot pan (15 seconds)
Step 29. Clear the vegetable scraps into the compost (2 minutes)
Step 30. Slice a lemon into wedges (1 minute)
Step 31. Wipe the rim of the egg bowl (30 seconds)
Step 32. Gently fold the omelette in half (30 seconds)
Step 33. Toast a slice of sourdough bread (3 minutes)
Step 34. Check the temperature of the skillet (30 seconds)
Step 35. Spread the crab filling over the eggs (1 minute)
Step 36. Squeeze a few drops of lime juice (10 seconds)
Step 37. Whisk in the chopped herbs (45 seconds)
Step 38. Clarify a small amount of butter (5 minutes)
Step 39. Finely slice the shallots (3 minutes)
Step 40. Organize all ingredients on the prep station (10 minutes)
Step 41. Mix the dressing for the side salad (2 minutes)
Step 42. Put on a cooking apron (30 seconds)
Step 43. Clean the cutting board (2 minutes)
Step 44. Thinly slice the cucumber (3 minutes)
Step 45. Soften the butter at room temperature (15 minutes)
Step 46. Peel the outer layer of the spring onions (1 minute)
Step 47. Mince the lemongrass stalk (4 minutes)
Step 48. Measure the sesame oil (30 seconds)
Step 49. Plate the omelette carefully (1 minute)
Step 50. Dry the salad greens in a spinner (2 minutes)
Step 51. Garnish with the lemon wedges (30 seconds)
Step 52. Wash the fresh produce (5 minutes)
Step 53. Open the tin of crab meat (1 minute)
Step 54. Store the leftover crab in the fridge (2 minutes)
Step 55. Prepare the soy sauce dip (2 minutes)
Step 56. Pat the spring onions dry (1 minute)
Step 57. Beat the eggs until frothy (2 minutes)
Step 58. Turn off the stovetop burner (10 seconds)
Step 59. Discard the eggshells (30 seconds)
Step 60. Sprinkle a pinch of sugar into the eggs (15 seconds)
Step 61. Prepare the garnish of sliced chilies (2 minutes)
Step 62. Stir the crab mixture one last time (30 seconds)
Step 63. Pour the dipping sauce into a ramekin (30 seconds)
Step 64. Place the omelette on the warmed plate (30 seconds)
Step 65. Sift a little cornstarch into the crab (1 minute)
Step 66. Toss the salad with the dressing (1 minute)
Step 67. Put the butter wrapper in the bin (10 seconds)
Step 68. Slide the omelette to the edge of the pan (20 seconds)
Step 69. Set the dipping sauce on the table (30 seconds)
Step 70. Wash the crab preparation bowl (3 minutes)
Step 71. Find the kitchen timer (1 minute)
Step 72. Adjust the gas flame to low (10 seconds)
Step 73. Serve the meal immediately (1 minute)
Step 74. Chop the garlic for the filling (2 minutes)
Step 75. Gather all the knives (1 minute)
Step 76. Place the side salad on the table (1 minute)
Step 77. Whisk the eggs with a fork (1 minute)
Step 78. Scrub the salad prep bowl (3 minutes)
Step 79. Dice the remaining ginger (2 minutes)
Step 80. Prepare the final presentation tray (2 minutes)
